headline: High: AutoGPT can write and egress while whisper is local-only audio CLI, creating default data-flow and compliance risks; prompt-injection and leakage are limited by the pair's weak direct coupling.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: AutoGPT can read and act on filesystem content and run shell commands, while whisper only exposes audio-file CLI usage and no shared channel is documented. The pair lacks a direct default bridge, so prompt injection is not provable beyond unusual manual file handoff. Uncertainty is limited but still present because AutoGPT's file parsing behavior is not fully specified.
conditions: IF an operator manually copies whisper output into files AutoGPT treats as instructions, injection becomes plausible.
IF AutoGPT is configured to ingest arbitrary filesystem text as prompts, attacker-controlled content can steer it.
mitigations: Keep whisper outputs in a separate directory from AutoGPT inputs.
Use a strict file naming convention for handoffs.
Review any text files before AutoGPT reads them.
Disable automatic ingestion of untrusted files.
requires-engineering: add provenance tags to handoff files.

B_data_leakage.rationale: AutoGPT has filesystem access and allowlisted network egress, while whisper is local-only with no network egress and only audio-file I/O. No shared workspace or sensitive data class is documented, so leakage is possible mainly through manual placement of files rather than a default exfiltration path. Because the pairwise interaction is only indirectly evidenced, severity stays low.
conditions: IF sensitive files are placed in a directory AutoGPT can read, AutoGPT may transmit their contents via allowlisted egress.
IF whisper outputs are stored alongside secrets, AutoGPT can ingest them into its context.
mitigations: Store secrets outside AutoGPT's working directory.
Use separate OS users for the two agents.
Restrict AutoGPT's readable paths to a scratch folder.
Audit outbound requests from AutoGPT for file-derived content.
requires-engineering: enforce per-directory access controls.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: AutoGPT can execute shell commands and spawn subprocesses, but whisper cannot write files, modify git state, or use network egress. There is no overlapping write surface or shared mutable resource in the profiles, so direct capability conflict is limited. The main uncertainty is that AutoGPT's filesystem write behavior is not explicitly listed, so I avoid assuming it.
conditions: IF AutoGPT is wrapped with additional write permissions not shown here, it could contend for shared files.
IF an external orchestrator gives both agents the same mutable workspace, conflicts become more likely.
mitigations: Run each agent in its own directory.
Avoid shared git repositories.
Serialize any file-producing steps.
Check for lockfiles before writes.
requires-engineering: add workspace locking.

D_cascading_error.rationale: AutoGPT can generate downstream actions from its own outputs, while whisper produces transcribed audio content that may be treated as authoritative input by an orchestrator. If whisper transcripts are fed into AutoGPT without verification, transcription errors can cascade into incorrect shell actions or file operations. The pathway exists in default CLI-style workflows, though not every deployment will wire them together.
conditions: IF whisper transcripts are passed into AutoGPT as task text, transcription mistakes can propagate.
IF AutoGPT is allowed to act on transcript-derived instructions without human review, downstream errors can execute.
mitigations: Require human review of transcripts before action.
Use confidence thresholds on transcription output.
Separate transcription from execution steps.
Log transcript-to-action mappings.
requires-engineering: add verification gates before shell execution.

E_compliance.rationale: AutoGPT is an open-source agent with filesystem and allowlisted egress, while whisper is a local speech model with no network egress and only audio-file I/O. No residency, certification, or retention mismatch is documented, and no PHI/PII class is explicitly listed. Compliance risk is therefore limited to operator-specific data handling rather than an inherent pairwise violation.
conditions: IF regulated audio is processed through AutoGPT's networked context, residency or retention obligations may be implicated.
IF the operator stores transcripts in a governed workspace, retention policy mismatches can arise.
mitigations: Keep regulated audio local.
Avoid sending transcripts to external services.
Document retention for transcript files.
Separate governed and non-governed datasets.
requires-engineering: add policy-aware routing.
